title: NO HALLOWEEN DRESSING
why: His answer 22 of 2026-10-12: no halloween dressing, forget and remove this concept. The arcade raid no longer burns every lamp orange, puts carved pumpkins by the lamps and doors or washes the screen in violet haze, and the arcade attract no longer reads HAPPY HALLOWEEN. An arcade raid now keeps the lamp colours its map gives it, the same as a normal raid. The code for the dressing is removed, not switched off.
now: The Halloween dressing is gone from the arcade: no pumpkins, no orange lamps, no haze, no banner.
